name: x-poster
description: Post a tweet or a linear thread (with optional image) to X from the terminal. Bring your own X app; OAuth2-PKCE bootstrap; dry-run cost preview; never auto-publishes.

env_file.title: X credentials env file
env_file.description: Absolute path to your writable env file holding X_CLIENT_ID, X_CLIENT_SECRET, and X_REFRESH_TOKEN. Rotated refresh tokens are written back here, so it must be writable and yours (never the read-only plugin dir). Create it from env/.env.example and mint the token with bin/x-auth.mjs. Optional: if unset, the command falls back to the X_ENV_FILE environment variable.
